resolved_blockers.resolution: Authority-only deterministic promotion is a separate transactional transition; publication still requires the current primary plus exactly two distinct eligible current replicas. Promotion does not write CheckpointClaims, BucketSnapshots or ReplicaCheckpoint.

Primary promotion and replica replacement process every indexed agreement whose capacity_state is not Released, including terminal-awaiting-release agreements; tests cover capacity/index movement, later release and hostile rollback.

The candidate and runtime test bind actual Commons BlockNumber=u32 and AccountId32 bytes for both the developer zero-metadata profile and the b17b1892 verification metadata profile; unknown metadata hashes fail closed.
A narrow normative amendment adds submit_checkpoint code 242 only for context-v1 signature mismatch while preserving codes 220 through 241 and keeping promotion codes 243 through 246 separate.

The candidate exhaustively identifies conditional service-key activation, provider and key-owner state, bucket/agreement roles and versions, shared admission, duty staging, replay receipt and events, with transactional rollback.

The shared 256 admission law is distinct from honestly additive backlog, release and agreement-index bounds; provider tests 7 through 11 remain required and explicitly move to G003/P2 without enabling premature completion claims.

approval.condition: This CLEAR applies only to the exact reviewed source commit/tree and exact four candidate hashes recorded above. Any byte change requires a new independent review.
